card.name: Figure and citation punctuation in old reference text
card.fires_on: Small punctuation or number marks inside reference-style text, such as the period after FIG or Fig before a figure number, a colon after a volume number, or a digit inside a date or atomic weight. Seen mostly in old anatomy books, dictionaries and citations.

modes.label: Figure labels
modes.description: The word FIG or the period right after Fig, just before a figure number in old anatomy text.

modes.label: Citation and date numbers
modes.description: Digits, spaces or colons inside journal citations, dates and measured values.

modes.label: Such as in examples
modes.description: The word such in an explanatory list of examples in an old text.
modes.example: anatomically inaccessible<< such>> as the spinal joints

card.writes: The promoted tokens are a mix of Chinese words and old-state names like Yugoslavia and USSR, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on small marks like the period in Fig. or numbers in old book citations and dates.
